results.notes: Spin-1/2 J1-J2 model with spin operators, J1 = 1, square lattices with periodic boundaries (Sec. Results), sampled in the sector with equal numbers of up and down spins (Sec. Model). The 8 x 8 cluster is compared with the periodic QMC energy of Sandvik (1997), -0.673487(4), in the same row; periodic boundaries as for the other clusters.
